decisions.decision: Accepted D-24 — CODEOWNERS is advisory on this repo — as a documented residual rather than compensating for it
decisions.rationale: Branch protection on main requires the `gate` check (strict) but carries no required_pull_request_reviews block and enforce_admins is false. `require_code_owner_reviews=true` is NOT the remedy it appears to be: GitHub forbids self-approval, so a solo repo where the sole code owner is the PR author cannot satisfy it without a second account or a per-merge admin waiver — already considered and declined at v2.3 RAT-5. Accepting is consistent with ADR-0012 (CI and the merge are the authority) and ADR-0013 clause (c) (no new enforcement). Re-openable in v2.6 as a machine-side check on golden baseline diffs, which v2.5's no-growth constraint forbade and which is now closed.

decisions.decision: Authored ADR-0013 to supersede ADR-0008, and ratified a keep-cited-targets rule with it
decisions.rationale: ADR-0012 superseded 0001 and 0010 by name but never mentioned 0008, whose whole subject Phase 43 deleted. Under this repo's precedence an accepted ADR wins a data conflict against code, so 0008 was telling agents the deletion was the error. The second clause ratifies what Phase 45 did without a rule behind it: a path cited by an accepted ADR is corrected or marked historical, never deleted, because the citing text is append-only and can never be repaired.

decisions.decision: Resolved D-14 as a finding rather than authoring a correction for ADR-0003
decisions.rationale: The handoff described two accepted ADRs citing files the milestone made stale. Measured, BOTH citation targets are live — docs/explanation/next-milestone-task-control-plane.md kept under a HISTORICAL header, and harness/agents/templates/component-engineer.md kept and corrected in place with two live gates depending on it. So ADR-0003 needs no correction; the real dangling references are the six deleted paths inside ADR-0008's own immutable Links section.

decisions.decision: The human ran the constitution-plane writes via an agent-prepared script instead of the agent setting a token
decisions.rationale: tools/hooks/contract_guard.py:55 puts docs/adr/** on CONSTITUTION_GLOBS alongside docs/glossary.md, so THREE of the four leftovers were human-gated, not one — correcting the handoff's own framing that the ADR was agent-authorable. GOLDEN_APPROVE_HUMAN must never be forged and HARNESS_DEV_BYPASS must not be used on a plane a gate protects. The working pattern: the agent prepares an off-plane script whose every replacement asserts an exact single match (mutation-tested both directions) with an ERR trap rolling back a partial apply, and the human runs it. .planning/quick/260729-wdi-*/apply.sh is the worked example.

decisions.decision: Corrected two stale declarations before archiving rather than letting the archive preserve them
decisions.rationale: ROADMAP had phases 43-46 unchecked while its own Progress table read Complete, and REQUIREMENTS' traceability read CER-01/02/03 as `Not started` against a Phase 39 VERIFICATION recording all three SATISFIED. Both are this milestone's defining defect class — a declaration that has quietly stopped meaning anything — so archiving them unchanged would have made the record permanently wrong.

context_notes: Milestone v2.5 is SHIPPED, ARCHIVED and TAGGED — a clean boundary, not a pause. Working tree clean; branch claude/data-pipeline-harness-8aypct and origin/main both carry the work. Final gates: core 881 passed / 7 snapshots, instance 14, contract-drift (core + workspace), emit-drift, stale-derived and the ruff ratchet all exit 0; commands 18. THE LESSON THAT MATTERS MOST is in memory as checks-that-cannot-fail, and it now has EIGHT instances, not six: the original six across phases 40-46 (RETIRED_SIGNATURES[0] reading one entry, a test asserting [] == [], a loop over an emptied edge list, deny rows whose only enforcer had been deleted, a glob set matching zero paths, three predicates passing on prose elsewhere in the same file), plus two found during this very close (ROADMAP's unchecked 43-46 against a Complete Progress table, and CER-01/02/03's `Not started`). The normal gates verify that declared things EXIST, never that declarations still MEAN something — so mutation-test every new or edited assertion, scope predicates to the section they govern, and count per-block rather than whole-file. Second: docs/adr/** is on CONSTITUTION_GLOBS, so authoring an ADR is human-gated exactly like docs/glossary.md; when an agent must not write, prepare an off-plane script with exact-single-match assertions and have the human run it. Third, mechanical: git commit needs its -m message BEFORE the --, and a NEW file needs an explicit targeted `git add` first, or `git commit -- <pathspec>` rejects the path outright.
